[!cgo] skip 'cgo is not available'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo

# Effectful arena calls preserve an imported type's source alias.
cd arena
logos run .
stdout '^duration: 1ns 1$'
cp stdout $WORK/arena.txt
logos eject -o $WORK/arena-out
cd $WORK/arena-out
exec env -u GOROOT GOEXPERIMENT= $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/arena.txt
exec env -u GOROOT GOEXPERIMENT= $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/arena.txt

# A method-bearing pointer union emits C types in its typed-nil checks.
cd $GOPATH/src/json
logos run .
stdout '^zero: [{]"value":7,"count":9[}]$'
cp stdout $WORK/json.txt
logos eject -o $WORK/json-out
cd $WORK/json-out
exec env -u GOROOT GOEXPERIMENT= $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/json.txt
exec env -u GOROOT GOEXPERIMENT= $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/json.txt

-- arena/go.mod --
module example.com/cgoarena

go 1.27

-- arena/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- arena/main.lgo --
package main

import "C"

import (
	"fmt"
	"logos/arena"
	clock "time"
)

var regions [1]arena.Region
var calls int

func tick() int { calls++; return 0 }

func main() {
	values := arena.Make[clock.Duration](regions[tick()], int(C.int(1)))
	values[0] = clock.Second
	fmt.Println("duration:", values[0]/clock.Second, calls)
}

-- json/go.mod --
module example.com/cgojson

go 1.27

-- json/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- json/main.lgo --
package main

/*
typedef unsigned long word;
*/
import "C"

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

type Item[T any] struct { Value T }

func (i Item[T]) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) { return json.Marshal(i.Value) }
func (i *Item[T]) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error { return json.Unmarshal(data, &i.Value) }
func (i *Item[T]) IsZero() bool { return false }

type Choice interface {
	*Item[C.int] | *Item[C.word]
	IsZero() bool
}

type Packet struct {
	Value Choice `json:"value,omitzero"`
	Count *C.int `json:"count"`
}

func main() {
	count := C.int(9)
	data, err := json.Marshal(Packet{Value: &Item[C.int]{Value: 7}, Count: &count})
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	fmt.Printf("zero: %s\n", data)
}
